handback.t:
Finding: ADDRESSED. `plugins/ruflo-console/hooks/commands.ts:27-39`. The multi-word page match (`named`) now runs only when `head` is not in the exported `VERBS`. `swarm topology` and `agent timeline` therefore reach the switch: `swarm` delegates to ruflo-swarm for a `SWARM_SUBS` word (line 62), and `agent` drills (line 84). `learning lab` and `claims board` still open their pages, because `learning` and `claims` are not verbs.

(a) The new spec passes: 4/4 with `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/commands-verbs.spec.ts`. I read the afef905 code and the spec does bite. Before the fix, `named = viewOf(words.join(' '))` ran ahead of the switch. In `hooks/state.ts:93-107`, `RETIRED_NAMES` maps `'swarm topology'` to `swarm` and `'agent timeline'` to `timeline`. So afef905 returned `{kind:'open',view:'swarm'}` and `{kind:'open',view:'timeline'}`, and the test's `toEqual` on the delegate and agent intents fails on both lines. I did not run it against the old code.

(b) The help-lines test is nearly vacuous, but the fix does not depend on it.
- Its regex only picks up lines where the verb is followed by a single space and a lowercase word. I ran that regex on `commands.ts`: every verb except `swarm` yields `arg = undefined`, so each parses as a one-word input. One-word input never reaches `named`, which needs `words.length > 1`. Those cases would pass even without the fix.
- The only two-word line it finds is `swarm pane`, which is in the skip list (open, agent, swarm, events, timeline). The skip condition makes the assertion trivially false for those five verbs, so they get no check at all from this test.
- For the skipped verbs, only `swarm topology` and `agent timeline` are asserted explicitly.
- Untested documented forms: `swarm pane|status|claims|consensus`, `agent <id>`, `events <args>`, `timeline <args>`.
- None of these can open a page through `named` any more. The guard is structural: any `VERBS` first word skips `named`. The remaining collision risk is a verb plus argument that happens to match a view id, label or retired name. Only `swarm topology` and `agent timeline` do today. `events` and `timeline` with arguments go to their own intents, and `swarm pane|status|claims|consensus` match no view or retired name.
- A test that covers the other forms would be cheap, but it is not needed for this finding.

(c) `VERBS` is checked against the switch, with a caveat.
- It is a hand-written array, not derived. The spec reads `commands.ts`, slices from `switch (head)` to `export const HELP`, collects `case '…':`, and asserts the sorted `VERBS` equals the sorted set of cases. That is a real drift guard.
- The empty `case ''` is not captured by the regex, and `VERBS` correctly omits it. A bare `/ruflo` has one word, so `named` is skipped anyway.
- Spot-checked against the switch at lines 49-112: `open`, `swarm`, `plan`, `events` and `filter` are all in `VERBS`. `?` and `p` are in as well.
- No view label or retired name other than the two intended collisions starts with a verb. I only skimmed the first ~15 `VIEWS` labels, but retired names are the only multi-word ones I found. `event stream` is singular and unaffected.

New breakage in the fix diff: none.

Out-of-scope observations:
- `open learning lab` ignores its arguments (`case 'open'` returns `view: null`). I did not compare this against base 88a1d1843.
- The task note said "derived from the switch", but `VERBS` is a manual list plus a test guard. That is acceptable.

Verdict: all findings addressed.
